## Ordering and claims
- Published product prices and shipping details may change. Always verify the current checkout or request a quote.
- Retail orders and wholesale inquiries follow separate quantity-based workflows. Check the live site for current terms.
- Any claim about sound reduction, shipping, import duties, U.S. sales tax, fulfillment, or delivery time should be verified against the specific product and delivery address.
- Do not infer that online payment is available from a displayed price. Checkout is enabled only when verified by the live order system.
- Product suitability depends on the surface, building construction, usage and supervision; silent balls are not guaranteed to eliminate all impact noise.
